run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum triplet sum in an array of integers
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and compare results to f_filled
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use sorting instead of brute force O(n^3) nested loops
review_f_gold: review f_gold which computes the maximum sum of any three elements in an array
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold a brute force algorithm that finds the maximum triplet sum
